lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white pixel clusters are arranged in at least six distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. The spatial arrangement follows a semi-regular grid pattern along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, creating a lattice-like visual structure where the blobs act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two primary longitudinal ridges are visible: one along the dorso-lateral boundary and one mid-lateral, both defined by a sharp intensity transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular, pale-toned patch lacking the standard dark-background pigmentation is visible on the upper mid-flank, superior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a dense concentration of smaller, high-luminance circular spots, particularly clustered along the leading edge and distal half of the fin surface.
